   283	
   284	def build_docker_argv(
   285	    action: str,
   286	    *,
   287	    image_ref: str,
   288	    user_data_dir: Path,
   289	    config_name: str = "config-ft00.json",
   290	    strategy: Optional[str] = None,
   291	    extra_args: Optional[List[str]] = None,
   292	    data_args: Optional[List[str]] = None,
   293	    name: str = CONTAINER_NAME,
   294	    detach: bool = False,
   295	    uid_gid: Optional[str] = None,
   296	    config_sha256: Optional[str] = None,
   297	) -> List[str]:
   298	    """Construct the docker command for a supported action. The pinned
   299	    image is embedded verbatim; the user_data workspace is the only
   300	    volume; no network publication is ever added.
   301	
   302	    ``data_args`` carries FIRST-CLASS typed download arguments (pairs /
   303	    timeframe / timerange) and must pass :func:`validate_data_args` —
   304	    the builder does not trust the caller to have validated them;
   305	    ``extra_args`` is the raw user-supplied remainder and must pass
   306	    :func:`validate_extra_args`.
   307	
   308	    When ``config_sha256`` (a full sha256 of the snapshot's bytes) is
   309	    given for a config-executing action, the container entrypoint
   310	    becomes ``/bin/sh -c '<copy> && <checksum check> && exec "$@"'``:
   311	    the mounted snapshot is FIRST copied to PRIVATE_CONFIG_PATH (the
   312	    container's own writable layer — never inside the mounted volume, so
   313	    no host-side process can touch it), the COPY's sha256 is verified,
   314	    and only then does freqtrade exec — reading the copy. This closes
   315	    the check-to-use race: the file freqtrade opens is never a path a
   316	    workspace-writer can replace, because check and use are the same
   317	    inode in container-private storage.
   318	
   319	    By default the container runs with the image's own lifecycle (root →
   320	    entrypoint chown of user_data to its internal ftuser → drop to
   321	    ftuser): freqtrade is pip-installed under ftuser's 0700 home, so an
   322	    explicit ``--user`` cannot reach the binary. Pass ``uid_gid``
   323	    explicitly only with an image that supports it."""
   324	    if image_ref != DEFAULT_PINNED_IMAGE or not DIGEST_RE.match(image_ref):
   325	        raise ValueError(
   326	            "image_ref must be exactly the pinned official reference "
   327	            f"{DEFAULT_PINNED_IMAGE!r}: got {image_ref!r}"
   328	        )
   329	    overlay = validate_extra_args(extra_args)
   330	    if overlay:
   331	        raise ValueError("; ".join(overlay))
   332	    data_findings = validate_data_args(data_args)
   333	    if data_findings:
   334	        raise ValueError("; ".join(data_findings))
   335	    if strategy is not None and not STRATEGY_RE.match(strategy):
   336	        # strategy is config-controlled text; it reaches docker argv and
   337	        # (in the hash-bound form) a shell script — only identifiers pass
   338	        raise ValueError(f"strategy {strategy!r} is not a plain identifier")
   339	    if not CONFIG_NAME_RE.match(config_name):
   340	        raise ValueError(f"config_name {config_name!r} has unsafe characters")
   341	
   342	    volume = f"{user_data_dir.resolve()}:/freqtrade/user_data"
   343	    config_arg = f"/freqtrade/user_data/{config_name}"
   344	    # In the sha-bound form freqtrade must read the CONTAINER-PRIVATE
   345	    # copy, never the mounted path (see PRIVATE_CONFIG_PATH). The
   346	    # builder refuses a private path that would fall inside the mount.
   347	    if config_sha256 is not None and action in ("download-data", "dry-run"):
   348	        if PRIVATE_CONFIG_PATH.startswith("/freqtrade/user_data/"):
   349	            raise ValueError(
   350	                "PRIVATE_CONFIG_PATH must live outside the mounted volume"
   351	            )
   352	        exec_config_arg = PRIVATE_CONFIG_PATH
   353	    else:
   354	        exec_config_arg = config_arg
   355	    cmd_args: List[str]
   356	    if action == "version":
   357	        cmd_args = ["--version"]
   358	    elif action == "download-data":
   359	        cmd_args = [
   360	            "download-data", "--config", exec_config_arg,
   361	            "--userdir", "/freqtrade/user_data",
   362	        ] + list(data_args or []) + list(extra_args or [])
   363	    elif action == "dry-run":
   364	        cmd_args = [
   365	            "trade", "--config", exec_config_arg,
   366	            "--userdir", "/freqtrade/user_data",
   367	            "--dry-run", "--strategy", strategy or "",
   368	        ] + list(extra_args or [])
   369	    else:
   370	        raise ValueError(f"unknown action {action!r}")
   371	
   372	    # Foreground commands self-clean with --rm; a detached smoke run must
   373	    # NOT use --rm, so a crash leaves the container's logs inspectable
   374	    # until we remove it explicitly after capturing evidence.
   375	    argv = ["docker", "run"]

   560	def collect_hackernews(
   561	    *,
   562	    top_n: int = 25,
   563	    collected_at: str,
   564	    first_seen_index: Dict[str, str],
   565	    fetch: Optional[Callable] = None,
   566	    retries: int = 3,
   567	) -> SourceResult:
   568	    def item_url(item_id: int) -> str:
   569	        return HN_ITEM_URL.format(item_id=item_id)
   570	
   571	    try:
   572	        ids, status, used_retries = http_get_json(
   573	            HN_TOPSTORIES_URL, retries=retries, fetch=fetch
   574	        )
   575	    except SourceUnavailableError as exc:
   576	        return SourceResult(
   577	            SOURCE_HN, "failed", error=str(exc),
   578	            http_status=exc.status, retries=exc.retries,
   579	        )
   580	    if not isinstance(ids, list):
   581	        return SourceResult(SOURCE_HN, "failed", error="topstories payload not a list")
   582	
   583	    records: List[EvidenceRecord] = []
   584	    errors = 0
   585	    for item_id in ids[:top_n]:
   586	        # int(item_id) on a float('inf')/huge-float id raises
   587	        # OverflowError — a malformed topstories entry is skipped and
   588	        # counted, never allowed to abort the source. bool is an int
   589	        # subclass but is not an item id; negative or implausibly huge
   590	        # ints are equally malformed entries, not fetchable items.
   591	        if (
   592	            not isinstance(item_id, int)
   593	            or isinstance(item_id, bool)
   594	            or not 0 < item_id <= _MAX_HN_ITEM_ID
   595	        ):
   596	            errors += 1
   597	            continue
   598	        try:
   599	            item, _, _ = http_get_json(item_url(item_id), retries=1, fetch=fetch)
   600	        except (SourceUnavailableError, ValueError, TypeError):
   601	            errors += 1
   602	            continue
   603	        if not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(
   604	            item.get("title"), str
   605	        ) or not item.get("title", "").strip():
   606	            # a fetched item with no usable title (non-string, empty or
   607	            # whitespace-only) is an item-level failure: count it,
   608	            # never silently drop it (round-11 finding 2)
   609	            errors += 1
   610	            continue
   611	        url_field = item.get("url")
   612	        source_url = (
   613	            url_field
   614	            if isinstance(url_field, str) and url_field
   615	            else f"https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id={item_id}"
   616	        )
   617	        event_id = stable_event_id(SOURCE_HN, str(item_id))
   618	        time_field = item.get("time")
   619	        try:
   620	            published = (
   621	                iso(datetime.fromtimestamp(time_field, tz=timezone.utc))
   622	                if isinstance(time_field, (int, float))
   623	                else None
   624	            )
   625	        except (ValueError, OverflowError, OSError):
   626	            published = None  # one bad item never aborts the source
   627	        try:
   628	            # float(10**400) is OverflowError: a valid-JSON integer can
   629	            # still be unrepresentable as a float — zero it like inf/NaN
   630	            score = float(item.get("score") or 0)
   631	            if not math.isfinite(score):
   632	                raise ValueError("non-finite score")
   633	        except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
   634	            score = 0.0  # inf/NaN must never reach the snapshot JSON
   635	        records.append(
   636	            EvidenceRecord(
   637	                event_id=event_id,
   638	                topic_id="hn:frontpage",
   639	                source=f"{SOURCE_HN}:news.ycombinator.com",
   640	                source_url=source_url,
   641	                published_at=published,
   642	                first_seen_at=first_seen_index.get(event_id, collected_at),
   643	                collected_at=collected_at,
   644	                raw_metric=score,
   645	                sampling_bias=(
   646	                    "HN front page skews tech-adjacent attention; score is "
   647	                    "platform engagement, not demand"
   648	                ),
   649	                source_access_rights=SOURCE_ACCESS_RIGHTS[SOURCE_HN],
   650	                # placeholder: overwritten after the loop so the count
   651	                # reflects ALL skipped ids, not just those before this
   652	                # record was appended
   653	                source_health="pending (final counts applied post-loop)",
   654	                uncertainty="medium (scores self-selected by community voting)",
   655	                window=collected_at[:10],
   656	            )
   657	        )
   658	    # final error count applied to EVERY record post-loop: an in-loop
   659	    # f-string froze the count as of each record's append, understating
   660	    # skips that happened after it
   661	    health = (
   662	        f"topstories http {status}; items={len(records)}; "
   663	        f"item errors={errors}"
   664	    )
   665	    for rec in records:
   666	        rec.source_health = health
   667	    return SourceResult(
   668	        SOURCE_HN, "ok" if records else "failed", records,
   669	        http_status=status, retries=used_retries,
   670	        error=None if records else (
   671	            f"no usable items (ids={len(ids[:top_n])}, "
   672	            f"item errors={errors}) — a source supplying zero evidence "
   673	            "is NOT healthy and cannot count toward the bounded snapshot"
   674	        ),
   675	    )

   678	def collect_kraken(
   679	    *,
   680	    pair: str = "BTCUSD",
   681	    interval_min: int = 60,
   682	    keep_candles: int = 24,
   683	    collected_at: str,
   684	    first_seen_index: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
   685	    fetch: Optional[Callable] = None,
   686	    retries: int = 3,
   687	) -> Tuple[SourceResult, Dict[str, Any]]:
   688	    url = KRAKEN_OHLC_URL.format(pair=pair, interval=interval_min)
   689	    try:
   690	        payload, status, used_retries = http_get_json(url, retries=retries, fetch=fetch)
   691	    except SourceUnavailableError as exc:
   692	        return SourceResult(
   693	            SOURCE_KRAKEN, "failed", error=str(exc),
   694	            http_status=exc.status, retries=exc.retries,
   695	        ), {}
   696	
   697	    # Shape-guard the payload before any .get(): a 200 response that is
   698	    # a list/string (or whose result is not an object) is a failed
   699	    # source, never an AttributeError aborting the probe.
   700	    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
   701	        return SourceResult(
   702	            SOURCE_KRAKEN, "failed", http_status=status, retries=used_retries,
   703	            error="kraken payload is not an object",
   704	        ), {}
   705	    errors = payload.get("error") or []
   706	    if errors:
   707	        return SourceResult(
   708	            SOURCE_KRAKEN, "failed", http_status=status, retries=used_retries,
   709	            error=f"kraken error payload: {errors}",
   710	        ), {}
   711	    result = payload.get("result")
   712	    if not isinstance(result, dict):
   713	        return SourceResult(
   714	            SOURCE_KRAKEN, "failed", http_status=status, retries=used_retries,
   715	            error="kraken result is not an object",
   716	        ), {}
   717	    candles: List[List[Any]] = []
   718	    result_key = None
   719	    for key, value in result.items():
   720	        if key == "last" or not isinstance(value, list):
